The '''Nomads Independence Day''' is a week-long festival celebrated in [[Fuchsia City]] annually. It commemorates the independence day of various nomadic tribespeople in [[Kanto]]. It appears exclusively in the {{pkmn|manga}} series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]].

Every year, members of several nomadic tribes congregate in the Fuchsia City area for a series of over 100 Pokémon races. The races are chiefly held amongst Pokémon of the same species, such as the Fuchsia {{p|Rattata}} Race and the {{p|Parasect}} Race. The festival culminates at the end of the week with the [[Fuchsia Free-For-All Race]], the biggest and most well-known of all the Independence Day races. The Free-For-All Race alone generates many tourists in Fuchsia City.

Aside from the races, there are other attractions during the Nomads Independence Day celebrations as well, such as street vendors.
